# Training Dummy (calc target)

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Mechanic tags:** mitigation, methodology, calc-target
- **Last verified:** 2026-06-10 by owner
- **Backlog:** `STDSUP-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Setup

The standard verification target: the **Level 85 dummy** with **30% elemental resistance, 30% erosion resistance, and 50% armor**. Confirm it's this dummy before any parse — a different dummy mitigates differently and breaks every comparison.

## Raw data points

Non-physical (elemental/erosion) effective multiplier ≈ **×0.49**; physical ≈ **×0.50** (armor applies at 60% to non-physical, hence the small split). Verified indirectly through the STDSUP-01 Chain Lightning L16 support sweep, where post-mitigation in-game numbers matched engine pre-mitigation × these factors within ±2% on long parses.

## Derived / confirmed formula

Non-physical taken = base × (1 − res) × (1 − armor_fraction). With 30% res + 50% armor (60% of armor applies to non-phys): ×0.70 × 0.70 ≈ **×0.49**. Physical ≈ **×0.50**.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

**Methodology, not a mechanic.** Always verify the app's "DPS vs Target" against the Recount **Average DPS in a span** (≥60–90 s, longer converges), NEVER the skill tooltip — the tooltip omits enemy debuffs (Numbed), multi-hit/shotgun, and Lucky's expected-value uplift. Use ratios where possible; they cancel the mitigation constant.
